instructions.value: For Maintain blocks, naturally experience the emotional state evoked by the images without attempting to regulate or alter it. For Reappraisal blocks, down-regulate the provoked negative affect using previously demonstrated cognitive reappraisal strategies such as reframing and rationalising. After each picture block, rate the intensity of negative affect from 1 (neutral) to 4 (negative).

spans.text: For half of the blocks, participants were instructed to naturally experience the emotional state evoked by the images, without attempting to regulate or alter it (Maintain blocks).
